items.html: And behold, since the Tifferet of Arich Anpin became a Neshama in the Hochma of ZA, as mentioned, therefore the thirty-two paths mentioned were revealed in this Hochma, and from there the thirty-two teeth were drawn into the mouth of ZA. And since the Tifferet of Arich Anpin was divided into two parts, therefore the thirty-two teeth were also divided into two: half in the upper palate and half in the lower palate. And since they are drawn from the twenty-four boundaries in the Tifferet of Arich Anpin, therefore their growth was also not completed until the end of the two years, corresponding to the two parts mentioned, which contain twenty-four months, corresponding to the twenty-four boundaries. And understand this. And behold, the opinion of the one who says that twenty-four months is the time of nursing has been explained.
